# Spacing Syntax

## Tight Pipes

|A|B|C|
|-|-|-|
|1|2|3|
|alpha|beta|gamma|
|longer left value|longer middle value|longer right value|

## Wide Padding

|   A   |   B   |   C   |
|  ---  |  ---  |  ---  |
|   1   |   2   |   3   |
|   alpha   |   beta   |   gamma   |
|   longer left value   |   longer middle value   |   longer right value   |

## Tab Padding

|	A	|	B	|	C	|
|	---	|	---	|	---	|
|	1	|	2	|	3	|
|	alpha	|	beta	|	gamma	|
|	longer left value	|	longer middle value	|	longer right value	|

## Mixed Padding

|A | B| C |
|--- | ---| --- |
|1 | 2| 3 |
|alpha | beta| gamma |
|longer left value | longer middle value| longer right value |
